# Charlotta & Lavendar Lewis

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Commands — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — employer who directs her house servant · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom antics from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) frightens her with ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set out to walk to a tea party in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), but accidentally wander down an enchanted wood lane that leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites the lost girls inside to join her for a tea party she had been playfully imagining by herself.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a merry tea party and explore the charming surroundings of [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's enchanting echoes and explains how her young maid came by her numerical moniker. Before the girls depart, a slip of the tongue brings up [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's name, leaving Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) visibly moved and quiet as she gives them lavendar and bids them farewell.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> During lunch, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) recounts [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's misadventure at the brook, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to leave the table in amusement. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. After enjoying food, echoes, and conversation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head out into a nearby pasture to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over Miss Lavendar's listlessness and lack of spirit, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to promise a week-long visit during her vacation to help cheer her up. After enjoying tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) about her imaginary dream-boy, forming a sweet bond of understanding with her before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for Stephen Irving's arrival. When Stephen arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him and ushers him into the parlor with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen cleaning silver until they spot Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking happily together in the garden, confirming their romantic reunion.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is buzzing with preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth helping out. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share their perspectives on the romance, highlighting the difference between seeing life through poetry versus prose. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are secretly engaged, leading to a heartfelt conversation between the two friends about love and their futures.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. She is warmly welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she comforts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a bedtime confession. Over the holidays, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from friends, visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enjoys reuniting with her loved ones.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) despite feeling a lonely ache from Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. She spends time with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) confronts the reality of growing up and leaving childhood imaginings behind. Later, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), gently warning her that they were meant for each other.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People
